rows.note: Use 馬騮 as the all-purpose colloquial word for the animal.

example.english: The monkey snatched the banana from my hand at the zoo.
example.traditional: 動物園入面隻馬騮搶咗我手上嘅香蕉。
example.jyutping: dung6 mat6 jyun4 jap6 min6 zek3 maa5 lau4 coeng2 zo2 ngo5 sau2 soeng6 ge3 hoeng1 ziu1

rows.note: Use 猴子 as a neutral, broadly understood term for the animal; 馬騮 is the usual colloquial Hong Kong choice.

example.english: There is a monkey at the zoo.
example.jyutping: dung6 mat6 jyun4 jap6 min6 jau5 zek3 hau4 zi2

rows.note: Use 馬騮仔 when teasingly calling a naughty or mischievous child a little monkey.

example.english: You little monkey, did you secretly eat all the sweets again?
example.traditional: 你個馬騮仔又偷偷哋食晒啲糖喇？
example.jyutping: nei5 go3 maa5 lau4 zai2 jau6 tau1 tau1 dei2 sik6 saai3 di1 tong4 laa3
